I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/libxml2`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
A heap-use-after-free exists in libxml2's error reporting: xmlParserPrintFileContextInternal (error.c) can read from parser input pointers that reference freed heap memory when invoked via xmlReportError/__xmlRaiseError. This results in reads of deallocated memory during parsing (e.g., while handling entities or external subsets), leading to crashes or other undefined behavior and potentially enabling exploitation.

arguments.command: bash -lc 'git -C /src/libxml2 status --porcelain || true; python -V; git -C /src/libxml2 rev-parse --short HEAD || true'

bash -lc 'python - << "PY"
import io,sys
p = "/src/libxml2/error.c"
with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    s = f.read()
pos = s.find("if ((input == NULL) || (input->cur == NULL))")
if pos == -1:
    print("Anchor not found; no patch applied", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
endl = s.find("
", pos)
if endl == -1:
    print("Malformed anchor line", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
insert_pos = endl + 1
patch = """
    if ((input->base == NULL) || (input->end == NULL))
        return;
    if ((input->cur < input->base) || (input->cur > input->end))
        return;
"""
new_s = s[:insert_pos] + patch + s[insert_pos:]
with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(new_s)
print("Patched error.c with base/end/null guards.")
PY'

bash -lc 'set -e; awk "/if \(\(input == NULL\) \|\| \(input->cur == NULL\)\)/ { print; getline; print; print \"    if ((input->base == NULL) || (input->end == NULL))\"; print \"        return;\"; print \"    if ((input->cur < input->base) || (input->cur > input->end))\"; print \"        return;\"; next } { print }" /src/libxml2/error.c > /tmp/error.c.new && mv /tmp/error.c.new /src/libxml2/error.c'
